description: Verify that DUT's Echo Reply carries an IPv4 header checksum matching the RFC 1071 one's-complement sum of the header words — emit path must compute the checksum correctly
approach:
[Objective]
While IPV4_CHECKSUM_02 covers receive-side validation, this case covers send-side computation. The Reply's checksum, if recomputed independently, must equal what's on the wire.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: Echo Reply
      - tester recomputes header checksum from the Reply's header words
      - that recomputed value must equal Reply's header_checksum field   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply's header_checksum equals the independently recomputed value.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_checksum — Reply emitted but its header_checksum did not match the recomputed sum
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window

verdicts.Pass: Reply checksum matched independent recomputation — normal emit
verdicts.Fail_checksum: Reply checksum did not match recomputation — emit path miscalculation
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
